issues.quote: Operating income advanced to $80.0 million in fiscal 2025 from $68.6 billion in fiscal 2024
issues.problem: Unit error: operating income should be $80.0 billion, not million. The stated 11.2% operating margin ($80.0B / $716.9B) only works in billions.

data.summary: Most figures are internally consistent: revenue growth of 12.4%, gross margin of 50.3% and an 11.2% operating margin. Net income growth of 31.1% fits once you allow for rounding. The one error is that operating income is given as $80.0 million instead of $80.0 billion.
